Late Drama in Stoppage Time As the clock ticked down, Yahia Fofana kept his side in the game with a string of heroic saves, denying Deniz Undav and Nathaniel Brown in the final minutes. Felix Nmecha played a sublime through ball to Deniz Undav , who kept his composure to fire a left-footed shot into the bottom corner. The late strike secured a hard-fought 2-1 victory for the European giants in a match that lived up to its billing.

matches.description: Watch Germany vs Paraguay highlights and goals from World Cup 2026 on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on June 29, 2026. On June 29, 2026 , the global stage was set for a monumental clash that tested the nerves of players and fans alike. This World Cup knockout encounter pushed both sides to their physical and mental limits in a display of pure footballing grit. South American Resilience Takes the Lead Paraguay began the match with an intensity that caught the European giants off guard. Early in the opening minutes, Júnior Alonso and Julio Enciso tested the reflexes of Manuel Neuer , forcing the veteran goalkeeper into crucial interventions. The Paraguayan pressure finally paid off in the 42nd minute. Following a corner, Matías Galarza delivered a pinpoint cross into the heart of the box, where Julio Enciso rose to head the ball into the bottom left corner, giving Paraguay the lead heading into the break. Germany attempted to respond quickly through Joshua Kimmich and Deniz Undav , but the Paraguayan defensive organization and several offside calls prevented an immediate equalizer. The first half ended with the sense that an upset was brewing under the lights. Havertz Responds for the Three-Time Champions The second half saw a more aggressive Germany , especially after the introduction of Leon Goretzka . German persistence was rewarded in the 54th minute: Florian Wirtz whipped in a cross and Kai Havertz clinicaly headed it into the bottom right corner to level the score. The game then became a back-and-forth battle, with Jamal Musiala coming off the bench to try and unlock the tactical deadlock. Paraguayan goalkeeper Orlando Gill began to emerge as the hero of the encounter, denying goals to Havertz and Kimmich with acrobatic saves that kept his side in the tie as regulation time wound down. VAR Intervention and Extra-Time Deadlock Extra time was defined by high tension and exhaustion. In the 102nd minute, Germany thought they had secured a late winner through Jonathan Tah , but the celebrations were cut short by a VAR intervention that ruled the goal out. Yellow cards for Havertz , Musiala , and Galarza illustrated the rising frustration on the pitch. Orlando Gill continued his masterclass, saving a point-blank header from Waldemar Anton in the dying moments of the second period of extra time. Heroics and Heartbreak in the Shootout With the sides inseparable after 120 minutes, the match moved to a penalty shootout. Paraguay showed nerves of steel, converting through Mauricio , Gustavo Gómez , and Matías Galarza . On the German side, drama struck as Kai Havertz and Nick Woltemade saw their efforts saved by the inspired Orlando Gill . Although Manuel Neuer gave Germany hope by saving from Fabián Balbuena , the fate of the match was sealed when Jonathan Tah fired his shot over the crossbar. José Canale stepped up to convert the final penalty, securing a historic 4-3 shootout victory for Paraguay .
